title: A variable metric coefficient in flat spacetime
promptMarkdown: Differentiate the coordinate transformation in the lesson and derive its metric. For $h>0$, derive the exact clock-rate and upward light-frequency ratios between $\xi=0$ and $\xi=h$. Derive the proper acceleration of a fixed-$\xi$ observer from its hyperbola. Does this experiment alone establish curvature? Name a measurement that can detect tidal effects.
hintLadder: Expand the two squares; cross terms cancel.
Frequency counts cycles per local proper time.
Compare the hyperbola radius with $c^2/\alpha$ in unit9.
